Remark
[Guiding principles for Ricci flow] 1. ch17:17.33\group Further Problems Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0057 The source asks for new guiding principles beyond heat-equation analogies, maximum principles, monotonicity, solitons, space-time quantities, and point picking, with particular emphasis on localization, weak continuation through singularities, higher dimensions, and special geometric structures.
